Oil prices are stabilizing after the U.S. and Iran said separately they would be sending delegations to Qatar, although Iran has denied that talks have been arranged with the United States. Brent crude, the international standard, was trading 0.2% lower at above $73 a barrel, slightly higher than pre-war levels. On Monday, Wall Street's benchmark S&P 500 added 1.2%.
